diagnosis: Frontier9 (56404796) sat at 2695 after 47 games: 7/4 against 2600-2700, 6/6 against 2700-2800. On 20 September a new public wave appeared one generation above its base: Tschinkel Metav4 v13 (40-0 against his own 2945 agent), Pipe-16 / V54 (the same bytes in four notebooks), Gluzdov One More Wheat, and Ahmed V51-V53 with a forecaster that sells one step before the recorded sale streams of the public agents. In the official engine Frontier9 splits 4/4 with each of them (mean -114..-188); Frontier8 fell to 10/50 in its last 50 live games.
screen_note: 7501-7504: round robin of the 20 September wave (stopped at 216/384 once the order was clear): gluzdov_omw > pipe16 = degnon_best (V54) = yummers2 > metav4 = hanif_sos > v53 inside the wave, by 28-78 coins. 7511-7516: f10_omw_pre, f10_omw_prelock, f10_pipe16_pre against gluzdov_omw, pipe16, metav4, v53, f9_pre4f: 12/0 (+950..+1140) against each Metav4-family agent, 10/2 against Frontier9, 5/7 against V53 (the unpatched bases score 2/6 there on the same seeds). The lockstep layer changed no result and is left out.
rule: Hash frozen before the holdout. Official engine, paired against the strongest unmodified public agent of the wave (gluzdov_omw) on identical opponents/seeds/seats. Gate: total paired score >= +10, mirror against the control >= 50%, no opponent with a paired delta below -2.0 (one world, both seats), no reported errors/fallbacks, every callback < 1000 ms. The Kaggle kernel then repeats the gate on four fresh seeds against three Metav4-family opponents (the verification notebook must stay under 1 MB, so all embedded agents share one sale library). Registered before the run.
attribution: Base: Dmitrii Gluzdov, One More Wheat (a derivative of Thomas Tschinkel, The Metav4 Farm v13, Apache-2.0, with the upstream authors credited in its source). Lab layer: lockstep sale ordering against a copy (frontier5_lockstep.py), unchanged. The pre-emption patch of Frontier9 was measured on this base and is not part of the candidate.
round1_outcome: f10_omw_pre (pre-emption on One More Wheat) FAILED the registered gate on seeds 7521-7528: total 161/192 against 147/192 for the control (paired +14), mirror 10/6, but paired -4 against pipe16 and -4 against metav4 (the unpatched base beats them 14/2 by 27-79 coins; the patched one wins bigger and loses three worlds in eight). Per-product ledgers of the lost worlds: milk and wool pre-emption gain, strawberry pre-emption loses 1.0-1.6k. Item-restricted variants (milk+wool, milk, wool) still lose 2-4 of 14 worlds to the base. Receipts kept as rejected_pre4f_holdout*.json.

round2.exploration: On the consumed seeds 7511-7516 and 7521-7528 (both seats) One More Wheat + Lab lockstep ordering alone scored 26/28 against gluzdov_omw, 26/28 against pipe16, 27/28 against metav4 (margins +39..+886, the only loss is the seat-asymmetric world 7524) and 15/28 against v53 (the base scores the same there).
round2.rule: Same gate as round 1, registered before the run: official engine, paired against gluzdov_omw on identical opponents/seeds/seats; total paired score >= +10, mirror >= 50%, no opponent with a paired delta below -2.0, no errors, every callback < 1000 ms; then the Kaggle kernel on four fresh seeds.
round2.outcome: Fresh seeds 7531-7538: 170/192 against 162/192 for the control (paired +8). Mirror 16/0 (+232), pipe16 16/0, metav4 16/0, every older agent 12/4..16/0 like the control, v53 6/10 like the control, v52 10/6 where the control has 11/5 (-2, one world), no errors, max 282 ms. The registered total threshold (+10) was NOT met: the control already wins 162 of 192, so only ties in its own mirror (+8) and one world each against pipe16 and metav4 were left to gain, and those were all gained. Reported as a shortfall of 2 points on the total criterion; every other criterion passed. Arturo decides.
